qualification.details: Coordinator Grade-I: Master's degree with at least 55% marks; nine years' experience as Assistant Professor in Academic Level 10 and above with educational administration experience, or comparable research/higher education institution experience, or five years' administrative experience as Assistant Registrar or equivalent. Desirable: experience in Establishment/Examinations/Finance. Assistant Librarian: Master's degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science or equivalent with at least 55% marks; consistently good academic record with knowledge of library computerization; must have cleared NET (UGC/CSIR) or SLET/SET, or hold a Ph.D. as per UGC (M.Phil./Ph.D.) Regulations, 2009 or 2016, subject to specified exemption conditions. System Analyst: First class M.E./M.Tech. (Computer Science & Technology/Information Technology)/MCA/M.Sc. (Computer Science/Information Technology) or equivalent; OR First class B.E./B.Tech. (Computer Science & Technology/Information Technology) or equivalent with two years' relevant experience. Desirable: CCNA/CCNP or equivalent certification. Library Assistant: Bachelor's degree in Library & Information Science or equivalent; typing speed of 30 words per minute in English; knowledge of computer applications. | Professor (Economics, Human Rights, Public Administration, Demographic Studies): Ph.D. with 10 research publications and a total research score of 120 as per UGC 2018 norms, and 10 years' teaching/research experience with evidence of guiding doctoral candidates; OR an outstanding professional with a Ph.D. and 10 years' relevant experience. Professor - Law: LL.M. and Ph.D. in Law, plus other UGC 2018 conditions for Professor. Professor - Civil/Electronics & Communication Engineering: Ph.D. in the relevant field with first class at Bachelor's or Master's level; minimum 10 years' teaching/research/industry experience (at least 3 years as Associate Professor); at least 6 SCI/UGC/AICTE-listed publications at Associate Professor level with 2 successful Ph.D. supervisions, OR 10 such publications. Associate Professor (Human Development & Family Studies, Hindi): Ph.D. in the relevant discipline; Master's with at least 55% marks; 8 years' teaching/research experience with 7 peer-reviewed publications and a research score of 75 as per UGC 2018 norms. Assistant Professor - English: Master's degree with 55% marks and NET/SLET/SET (or Ph.D. as per UGC exemption conditions), OR a Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked in the top 500 globally (QS/THE/ARWU). Assistant Professor - Education (as per NCTE Regulations): Postgraduate degree in Social Sciences (55%) + M.Ed. (55%), OR PG in Education (55%) + B.Ed./B.El.Ed. (55%); plus UGC-NET/JRF/Ph.D. in Education. For Curriculum & Pedagogic subjects, a relevant PG subject + M.Ed. (55% each) is required; for Music/Fine Arts, only a PG degree in the subject with 55% marks is required. Professor-cum-Resident Director: Same eligibility as Professor (Category A or B above) plus three years of administrative experience for direct recruitment; for deputation, holding an analogous Academic Level-14 post, or at least 3 years in Academic Level-13A and above as Associate Professor or equivalent. Associate Professor-cum-Deputy Director (CSSI): Ph.D. in any Social Science subject; Master's with 55% marks; 8 years' relevant experience with 7 publications and a research score of 75. Assistant Professor-cum-Assistant Director (CSSI): Master's degree in Social Science with 55% marks and NET/SLET/SET (or Ph.D. exemption as per UGC norms), OR a foreign-university Ph.D. ranked in the top 500 globally. | Detailed, post-wise UGC 2018 eligibility clauses (including NET/SLET/SET exemption conditions for Ph.D. holders) are given in full in the official notification and should be read carefully before applying.

selection_process: Screening of applications as per eligibility criteria; the ratio of candidates called for interview to vacancies is generally up to 1:15. Written test with an objective-type qualifying paper (Paper I
minimum 40% qualifying marks) and a descriptive-type paper (Paper II
100 marks); only candidates clearing Paper I are evaluated in Paper II. Candidates securing 50% marks in Paper II are called for the skill test/interview
wherever applicable. Skill test carries 50 marks with a minimum qualifying score of 25. The final merit list is based on Paper II (descriptive test) marks
subject to qualifying the skill test. Interview marks
carry 20% weightage and are added to the Paper II/single written test score for the final merit list. The University may
hold a single written (descriptive) test and skill test instead of the two-stage process
depending on the post and number of candidates.

Selection is made purely on the basis of Interview. Meeting the eligibility criteria alone does not guarantee a call for interview. The Screening Committee shortlists candidates as per University rules and UGC Regulations
2018 (using the Academic Score in Appendix II
wherever applicable). The Selection Committee's/University's decision on eligibility
and selection is final and binding.
how_to_apply: Visit the official BBAU website: www.bbau.ac.in.
Locate the relevant recruitment notification link (Teaching - BBAU/T/01/2026, or Non Teaching - BBAU/NT/02/2026).
Read the General Instructions and Essential Information carefully before starting.
Register and fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and experience details.
Prepare self-attested PDF copies of all required documents in advance and upload them as per the specified format.
Pay the non-refundable application fee online as applicable to your category.
Submit the form before the deadline of 19.10.2026 (23:59:59 hrs) and save/print the confirmation for future reference.
Candidates applying for deputation posts must also send a hard copy of the application with supporting documents to the Registrar's office within 10 days of the last date.

content_sections.heading: BBAU Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is the same for both Teaching and Non Teaching notifications. The mode of fee payment is not specified in the document beyond "along with fees submission" during online application; candidates should check the payment gateway options on the official application portal.

content_sections.heading: BBAU Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening of applications as per eligibility criteria; the ratio of candidates called for interview to vacancies is generally up to 1:15. Written test with an objective-type qualifying paper (Paper I, 100 marks, minimum 40% qualifying marks) and a descriptive-type paper (Paper II, 100 marks); only candidates clearing Paper I are evaluated in Paper II. Candidates securing 50% marks in Paper II are called for the skill test/interview, wherever applicable. Skill test carries 50 marks with a minimum qualifying score of 25. The final merit list is based on Paper II (descriptive test) marks, subject to qualifying the skill test. Interview marks, wherever applicable, carry 20% weightage and are added to the Paper II/single written test score for the final merit list. The University may, at its discretion, hold a single written (descriptive) test and skill test instead of the two-stage process, depending on the post and number of candidates. Selection is made purely on the basis of Interview. Meeting the eligibility criteria alone does not guarantee a call for interview. The Screening Committee shortlists candidates as per University rules and UGC Regulations, 2018 (using the Academic Score in Appendix II, Table 3A, for shortlisting only, wherever applicable). The Selection Committee's/University's decision on eligibility, shortlisting, and selection is final and binding.

content_sections.heading: BBAU Recruitment 2026 Required Documents
content_sections.text: Duly filled online application form (printout, where applicable) Self-attested educational certificates and mark sheets (10th/matriculation certificate for date of birth and name proof) Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC Non-Creamy Layer/EWS/PwBD) in the Government of India prescribed format, if applicable Experience certificates relevant to the post applied for Publications and research score documentation (for Teaching posts, as per UGC Appendix II) No Objection Certificate/endorsement from the current employer, for candidates already working in Government/PSU/Autonomous bodies For deputation posts: hard copy of the online form with self-attested documents, certified SAR (Self-Appraisal Report) copies for the last five years, Vigilance Clearance Certificate, and NOC, to be sent to the Registrar, BBAU, within 10 days of the last date of online submission Original documents for verification at the time of written test/skill test/interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BBAU Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official BBAU website: www.bbau.ac.in . Locate the relevant recruitment notification link (Teaching - BBAU/T/01/2026, or Non Teaching - BBAU/NT/02/2026). Read the General Instructions and Essential Information carefully before starting. Register and fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and experience details. Prepare self-attested PDF copies of all required documents in advance and upload them as per the specified format. Pay the non-refundable application fee online as applicable to your category. Submit the form before the deadline of 19.10.2026 (23:59:59 hrs) and save/print the confirmation for future reference. Candidates applying for deputation posts must also send a hard copy of the application with supporting documents to the Registrar's office within 10 days of the last date.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BBAU Non-Teaching Positions?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application form along with fees is 19 October 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Non-Teaching Positions at BBAU?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies announced for various Non-Teaching Positions and Academic Staff at Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University (BBAU) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for BBAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification varies by post, but generally includes a Bachelor's degree, Master's Degree, M.E./M.Tech, MCA, or M.Sc. Please refer to the specific post details for exact educational requirements.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for BBAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1,000/- for General/OBC (Non Creamy Layer) candidates and Rs. 500/- for SC/ST/EWS/PwBD/Women candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Coordinator Grade-I post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Coordinator Grade-I post is 50 years. However, internal candidates may receive age relaxation, with no age limit mentioned for them.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the BBAU Non-Teaching Positions?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official website of BBAU. The application process involves filling out the form, uploading documents, and paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the recruited posts?
faq.answer: The salary is based on the 7th CPC Pay Levels. Coordinator Grade-I will be in Level 12, Assistant Librarian and System Analyst in Level 10, and Library Assistant in Level 04.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The notification mentions age relaxation for internal candidates for the Coordinator Grade-I post. Specific details for other categories should be checked in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for BBAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves screening of applications, followed by a Written Test, Skill Test, and an Interview.
